query:
SELECT 
  c.id,
  c.claim_number,
  c.document_processing_status,
  c.status,
  c.pipeline_current_stage,
  c.ai_assessment_triggered,
  c.ai_assessment_completed,
  c.updated_at
FROM claims c
WHERE claim_number NOT LIKE 'TEST-%'
  AND c.document_processing_status IN ('failed', 'uploaded')
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
